title: feature
description: features/<name>/feature.json. The folder is the feature; every document under it belongs to it. This file says what the folder cannot: which features it may reference, what it exports to them, and which effectful native operations its data layer may reach.

$schema.description: The kind of this document: its published schema URL, or the alias @wilanis/feature.schema.json.

description.description: What this feature is for, in one or two sentences.

label.description: A short human name for this document, shown wherever a reader sees it instead of its path. Absent: the file name stands in.

dependsOn.description: The other features this one may reference. A document may only name a document of its own feature or of one listed here.

items.description: The name of a feature folder this one may reference: kebab-case.

exports.description: Paths other features may name: ports and core shapes.

effects.description: The effectful operations this feature allows a binding to reach, each as path#operation. A delegation to one not listed here is refused (L003).
